construct_optimizer_sgd: build a PyTorch SGD optimizer with separate weight decay for batchnorm and non-batchnorm parameters
construct_optimizer_adam: build a PyTorch Adam optimizer with separate weight decay for batchnorm and non-batchnorm parameters
construct_optimizer_adamw: build a PyTorch AdamW optimizer with separate weight decay for batchnorm and non-batchnorm parameters
get_epoch_lr: retrieve the learning rate for a given training epoch based on the configured lr policy
set_lr: set the learning rate across all parameter groups of an existing PyTorch optimizer
